# API reference

Every function, property id, hook and map event CMF 1.0.0 offers to mods (API version 6). The signatures are read from `cmfCore.ws`, and the list of calls from the pack tool, which refuses any other `CMF...` call. "Since" is the API version that added it: check it with `CMFRequireVersion`, or ask `CMFHasProperty` or `CMFHasAbility` first. "Explained on" names the pages that use it.

## Functions

| Function | Since | What it does | Explained on |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CMFGetVersion() : int` | 1 | The installed CMF interface version (`6` in CMF 1.0.0). | [Getting started](Getting-Started.md), [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md) |
| `CMFHasProperty(propertyId : int) : bool` | 1 | `true` when the installed CMF understands that property id. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Legend rows and filter tabs](Legend-Rows-and-Filter-Tabs.md), [Hiding pins](Hiding-Pins.md) |
| `CMFRegister(provider : string, propertyId : int, target : name, mapContext : name, text : string, number : int) : bool` | 1 | One claim for a pin type (a map area for property 4). | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Pin size, labels and the info box](Pin-Size-Labels-and-Info-Box.md), [Pin clicks](Pin-Clicks.md) |
| `CMFRegisterBackground(provider : string, area : name, imageRoot : string)` | 1 | Replaces the map image of one area, such as `'AN_NMLandNovigrad'` (Velen and Novigrad). | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md) |
| `CMFRegisterDisabled(provider : string, pinType : name, mapContext : name, disable : bool)` | 1 | Draws every pin of that type greyed (grey art at reduced opacity, tint skipped). | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Greying pins](Greying-Pins.md) |
| `CMFRegisterDisabledForTag(provider : string, pinTag : name, mapContext : name, disable : bool)` | 1 | The same for one pin by its tag; it beats type-level claims on that pin. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Greying pins](Greying-Pins.md) |
| `CMFRegisterForTag(provider : string, propertyId : int, pinTag : name, mapContext : name, text : string, number : int) : bool` | 1 | The same for one pin by its tag; accepts properties 1, 5, 9, (API version 4) 10 to 13 and 15, (API version 5) 17 and (API version 6) 16, 20 and 21 (`reason=level` otherwise). | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Porting a map mod](Porting-a-Map-Mod.md), [Hiding pins](Hiding-Pins.md) |
| `CMFRegisterIcon(provider : string, pinType : name, url : string)` | 1 | Replaces the art of every pin of that type, and its legend row art unless you register a legend icon too. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Getting started](Getting-Started.md), [Check and build](Check-and-Build.md) |
| `CMFRegisterIconForTag(provider : string, pinTag : name, url : string)` | 1 | Replaces the art of one pin, identified by its map pin tag. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Choosing pin types](Choosing-Pin-Types.md) |
| `CMFRegisterLegendIcon(provider : string, pinType : name, url : string)` | 1 | Sets only the legend row art for that type. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Choosing pin types](Choosing-Pin-Types.md), [Check and build](Check-and-Build.md) |
| `CMFRegisterTint(provider : string, pinType : name, rgb : int)` | 1 | Multiplies the type's pin art by a colour. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Check and build](Check-and-Build.md), [Porting a map mod](Porting-a-Map-Mod.md) |
| `CMFReleaseProvider(provider : string)` | 1 | Withdraws everything your pack registered. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Shipping your mod](Shipping-Your-Mod.md), [Greying pins](Greying-Pins.md) |
| `CMFRequireVersion(provider : string, minVersion : int) : bool` | 1 | Returns `false` and logs a line when the installed CMF is older than `minVersion`. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Install and test](Install-and-Test.md), [Greying pins](Greying-Pins.md) |
| `CMFPropertyBackground() : int` | 1 | Returns property id `4`. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md) |
| `CMFPropertyDisabled() : int` | 1 | Returns property id `5`. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md) |
| `CMFPropertyIcon() : int` | 1 | Returns property id `1`. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md) |
| `CMFPropertyLegendIcon() : int` | 1 | Returns property id `2`. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md) |
| `CMFPropertyTint() : int` | 1 | Returns property id `3`. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md) |
| `CMFRegisterLegendCategory(provider : string, category : name, label : string, priority : int)` | 2 | Declares a filter tab after the vanilla tabs. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Legend rows and filter tabs](Legend-Rows-and-Filter-Tabs.md) |
| `CMFRegisterLegendLabel(provider : string, filteredType : name, label : string)` | 2 | Names a legend row. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Legend rows and filter tabs](Legend-Rows-and-Filter-Tabs.md), [Adapter: All Quest Objectives](Adapter-All-Quest-Objectives.md) |
| `CMFRegisterLegendRow(provider : string, filteredType : name, category : name, priority : int)` | 2 | Places a legend row in a filter tab; see [Legend rows and filter tabs](Legend-Rows-and-Filter-Tabs.md). | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Legend rows and filter tabs](Legend-Rows-and-Filter-Tabs.md), [Adapter: All Quest Objectives](Adapter-All-Quest-Objectives.md) |
| `CMFStylePin(provider : string, dataObject : CScriptedFlashObject, propertyId : int, text : string, number : int) : bool` | 2 | Styles one pin object for this map opening; properties 1, 3 and 9, (API version 4) 10 to 13 and 15, (API version 5) 17 and (API version 6) 16, 20 and 21. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Pin size, labels and the info box](Pin-Size-Labels-and-Info-Box.md), [Styling one pin](Styling-One-Pin.md) |
| `CMFStylePinIcon(provider : string, dataObject : CScriptedFlashObject, url : string) : bool` | 2 | `CMFStylePin` with property 1. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Styling one pin](Styling-One-Pin.md), [Adapter: Map Quest Insight](Adapter-Map-Quest-Insight.md) |
| `CMFStylePinTint(provider : string, dataObject : CScriptedFlashObject, rgb : int) : bool` | 2 | `CMFStylePin` with property 3. | [Styling one pin](Styling-One-Pin.md), [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Adapter: Map Quest Insight](Adapter-Map-Quest-Insight.md) |
| `CMFPropertyLegendCategory() : int` | 2 | Returns property id `8`. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md) |
| `CMFPropertyLegendLabel() : int` | 2 | Returns property id `7`. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md) |
| `CMFPropertyLegendRow() : int` | 2 | Returns property id `6`. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md) |
| `CMFHidePin(provider : string, dataObject : CScriptedFlashObject) : bool` | 3 | Hides one pin object for this map opening; `CMFStylePin` with property 9. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Hiding pins](Hiding-Pins.md), [The pin hook: `OnPinReady`](Pin-Hook-OnPinReady.md) |
| `CMFRegisterHidden(provider : string, pinType : name, mapContext : name, exemptions : string, hide : bool)` | 3 | Hides every pin of a type or `filteredType` (`''` for every pin) in one map context (`''` for every context); `hide` `false` withdraws. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Hiding pins](Hiding-Pins.md) |
| `CMFRegisterHiddenForTag(provider : string, pinTag : name, mapContext : name, exemptions : string, hide : bool)` | 3 | The same for one pin by its tag. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Hiding pins](Hiding-Pins.md) |
| `CMFPropertyHidden() : int` | 3 | Returns property id `9`. | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Hiding pins](Hiding-Pins.md) |

## Property ids

The generic calls `CMFRegister`, `CMFRegisterForTag` and `CMFStylePin` take one of these ids. Write an id newer than the CMF you require as its number, behind `CMFHasProperty`. Ids 18 and 19 are kept for later tooltip properties.

| Id | Function | Since | Explained on |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `1` | `CMFPropertyIcon()` | 1 | [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md) |

## Hooks

Wrap these methods of `CMFCore` with `@wrapMethod(CMFCore)` and always call `wrappedMethod` so other mods' wrappers run too. A click hook acts only when `provider` is your own folder name and passes every other call on.

| Hook | Since | Explained on |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OnPinReady(dataObject : CScriptedFlashObject, mapContext : name)` | 4 | [The pin hook: `OnPinReady`](Pin-Hook-OnPinReady.md), [Writing your script](Writing-Your-Script.md), [Choosing pin types](Choosing-Pin-Types.md) |
| `OnMapReady(menuFlash : CScriptedFlashSprite)` | 4 | [Drawing on the map itself](Drawing-on-the-Map.md), [The pin hook: `OnPinReady`](Pin-Hook-OnPinReady.md) |
| `OnPinClicked(menu : CR4MapMenu, provider : string, pinTag : name, pinId : int, pinType : string, input : string, value : int) : bool` | 6 | [Pin clicks](Pin-Clicks.md), [Drawing on the map itself](Drawing-on-the-Map.md), [Adapter: All Quest Objectives](Adapter-All-Quest-Objectives.md) |
| `OnDrawingClicked(menu : CR4MapMenu, provider : string, id : name, input : string, value : int) : bool` | 6 | [Drawing on the map itself](Drawing-on-the-Map.md), [Map theme parts and keys](Theme-Parts-and-Keys.md), [Adapter: Witcher's Path](Adapter-Witchers-Path.md) |
| `OnMapListening(menu : CR4MapMenu, keys : string)` | 6 | [Drawing on the map itself](Drawing-on-the-Map.md), [Adapter: Witcher's Path](Adapter-Witchers-Path.md) |

## Map events

CMF's map calls these events on `CR4MapMenu` under CMF's own names. Add one with `@addMethod(CR4MapMenu) event ...` to react.

| Event | Since | When | Explained on |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OnCMFMapFilter(category : string)` | 4 | each time the legend shows a filter tab, with its name | [Key hints and filter tab reports](Key-Hints-and-Filter-Tab-Reports.md), [Shipping your mod](Shipping-Your-Mod.md), [Adapter: Gwent Players Map](Adapter-Gwent-Players-Map.md) |
| `OnCMFMapHintsReady()` | 4 | once per opening, when the map listens for your key hints | [Shipping your mod](Shipping-Your-Mod.md), [Key hints and filter tab reports](Key-Hints-and-Filter-Tab-Reports.md), [Adapter: Ink and Iron](Adapter-Ink-and-Iron.md) |

## What each API version added

- **1**: `CMFGetVersion`, `CMFHasProperty`, `CMFPropertyBackground`, `CMFPropertyDisabled`, `CMFPropertyIcon`, `CMFPropertyLegendIcon`, `CMFPropertyTint`, `CMFRegister`, `CMFRegisterBackground`, `CMFRegisterDisabled`, `CMFRegisterDisabledForTag`, `CMFRegisterForTag`, `CMFRegisterIcon`, `CMFRegisterIconForTag`, `CMFRegisterLegendIcon`, `CMFRegisterTint`, `CMFReleaseProvider`, `CMFRequireVersion`
- **2**: `CMFPropertyLegendCategory`, `CMFPropertyLegendLabel`, `CMFPropertyLegendRow`, `CMFRegisterLegendCategory`, `CMFRegisterLegendLabel`, `CMFRegisterLegendRow`, `CMFStylePin`, `CMFStylePinIcon`, `CMFStylePinTint`
- **3**: `CMFHidePin`, `CMFPropertyHidden`, `CMFRegisterHidden`, `CMFRegisterHiddenForTag`
- **4**: `CMFLabelHideCrosshair`, `CMFLabelHidePin`, `CMFLevelLabel`, `CMFPropertyInfoBoxHeight`, `CMFPropertyLabelHide`, `CMFPropertyLabelPlace`, `CMFPropertyLabelText`, `CMFPropertyPinScale`, `CMFPropertyTabHide`, `CMFStylePinLabel`, `CMFStylePinScale`, hook `OnPinReady`, hook `OnMapReady`
- **5**: `CMFDraw`, `CMFDrawSet`, `CMFHasAbility`, `CMFPropertyLabelColor`, `CMFStylePart`
- **6**: `CMFDrawSetList`, `CMFMapRefresh`, `CMFPropertyCategoryNoDefault`, `CMFPropertyPinClick`, `CMFPropertyPinClickButton`, `CMFPropertyPinClickHint`, `CMFPropertySpreadRank`, `CMFRegisterCategoryNoDefault`, hook `OnPinClicked`, hook `OnDrawingClicked`, hook `OnMapListening`
